issues.location: codomain of the curried input construction
issues.finding: The sentence describes g as mapping constructions of A and B to constructions of C, but writes the codomain as $C$ rather than the section's formula metavariable $!C$.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use $!C$ for the output formula in the translated construction sentence.

issues.location: first name of the curried output function
issues.finding: The function is first called k_M but immediately defined and used as k_{g,M}; the latter records dependence on both g and M.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use k_{g,M} consistently in the translated construction.

issues.location: left injection h_1 in the double-negated excluded-middle construction
issues.finding: The source says h_1 maps an A-construction M_1 to the tagged pair (1,M_2), but M_2 belongs to the opposite disjunct; the left injection must carry M_1.
issues.proposed_resolution: Map M_1 to the tagged pair (1,M_1) in the translated proof.

translation_treatment: Translated BHK construction clauses and all worked proofs while correcting a missing formula metavariable marker, curried-function name, and wrong tagged-pair witness. The frozen source and composition macro remain unchanged.
